result_contracts.agent_task: Agent Run command accepts only agent_run with an authenticated agent actor and an active DeploymentRevision binding
result_contracts.integration_task: IntegrationRun plus immutable IntegrationAttempt; new commands require active TargetRevision, active GraphRevision, IntegrationTask WorkNode, ConnectorVersion, active Connection, commit, criterion, environment, provider reference, idempotency key, and credential-free Provider Receipt
result_contracts.human_task: immutable HumanWorkResult bound to active TargetRevision, active GraphRevision, HumanTask WorkNode, authenticated user, input hash, structured result hash, and optional ArtifactRevision or attachment hashes

compatibility_proof.legacy_integration_runs: new IntegrationRun binding columns remain nullable for pre-T004 rows and read as explicit null with an empty attempts array

idempotency_and_immutability.integration: one lifecycle receipt, IntegrationRun, and attempt number 1 are committed atomically; replay returns the original resource
idempotency_and_immutability.human: principal-scoped command receipt and unique principal idempotency key replay the original immutable result
idempotency_and_immutability.attempt_uniqueness: unique IntegrationRun plus attempt number and Workspace plus Connection plus idempotency key
idempotency_and_immutability.fact_updates: no update command exists for IntegrationAttempt or HumanWorkResult; WorkNode status transition is the only mutable projection in the transaction

tdd.red: Shared contract RED failed because complete IntegrationRun fields and HumanWorkResult were absent; behavior tests also exposed omitted dependency lists persisting as JSON null and never becoming ready.
tdd.green: Expand migration, strict shared validators, Go commands/stores, TypeScript facade routes, and read-model mappings passed focused and PostgreSQL-backed suites.
tdd.refactor: Nil dependency lists are normalized to [] before persistence so dependency-free nodes activate deterministically; result authority uses a separate user-or-service allowlist.

all Domain API HTTP, orchestration, and target packages passed with database-backed tests

residual_risks: T004 creates the first IntegrationAttempt atomically; retry scheduling and additional-attempt orchestration remain T005/T009 work.
